english.title: Provide false information to relevant officer performing maritime enforcement functions - immigration
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required to provide information by **(..NAME OF OFFICER..), a relevant officer in the performance of functions under Part A1 of Schedule 4A to the Immigration Act 1971, provided information that was false in a material particular, knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph K1(2)(a) and (4) of Schedule 4A to the Immigration Act 1971.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Rhoi gwybodaeth ffug i swyddog perthnasol a oedd yn cyflawni swyddogaethau gorfodi morwrol - mewnfudo
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), yn dilyn cael cais i roi gwybodaeth gan **(..NAME OF OFFICER..), swyddog perthnasol a oedd yn cyflawni swyddogaethau o dan Ran A1 o Atodlen 4A i Ddeddf Mewnfudo 1971, bu ichi ddarparu gwybodaeth a oedd yn cynnwys manylyn penodol anwir, gan wybod bod yr wybodaeth yn ffug neu drwy fod yn fyrbwyll
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i baragraff K1(2)(a) a (4) o Atodlen 4A i Ddeddf Mewnfudo 1971.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limits for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before the coming into force of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
